evidence.title: 世界先進積體電路股份有限公司
evidence.claim:
本批實際擷取公開頁面之產品／技術佐證（截錄）：VIS offers 8" foundry's most comprehensive and competitive power management process technologies including Bipolar-CMOS-DMOS (BCD), Ultra High Voltage (UHV) and Silicon-on-Insulator (SOI).

##### BCD

![Image](https://www.vis.com.tw/assets/images/technology/bcd.png)

##### BCD

VIS' BCD technology provides wide spectrum of voltage rating from 5V to 120V with geometry from 0.5µm to 0.11µm. VIS' BCD technology features the most competitive low Rsp performance for high efficiency, high current and form factor limitation applications in mobile, consumer and computing markets; and high quality of robustness and reliability for automotive and industrial applications.

In addition, VIS' BCD technology also provides wide variety of embedded Non-Volatile Memory (eNVM) IPs, including One-Time-Programing (OTP) and Multiple-Time-Programing (MTP) IPs, for smart power management design like USB power delivery, quick charger, wireless charger, smart lighting and motor driver applications. Moreover, VIS also offers ultra-high voltage capacitive insulator module (>5KV) on selected BCD technology for galvanic isolation application.

![Image](https://www.vis.com.tw/assets/images/technology/bcd_application.png)

##### UHV

![Image](https://www.vis.com.tw/assets/images/technology/uhv.png)

##### UHV

VIS offers the best-in-class 0.5um UHV technology with voltage rating from 200V to 700V for green energy applications. VIS' UHV technology features high reliability devices and the best fit processes for solid state lighting, AC/DC adapter and motor driver applications.

![Image](https://www.vis.com.tw/assets/images/technology/uhv_application.png)

##### SOI

![Image](https://www.vis.com.tw/assets/images/technology/soi.png)

##### SOI

VIS offers BCD-on-SOI process with voltage rating from 10V to 200V and geometry from 0.5um to 0.15um. The SOI process provides the ultimate isolation solution for noise and temperature sensitive design in automotive, medical and industrial applications. In addition, VIS' BCD-on-SOI provide high precision thin film resistor (SiCr) that enables high precision analog feature design.

![Image](https://www.vis.com.tw/assets/images/technology/soi_application.png)

roles.roleSummary: 世界先進MOPS支持晶圓代工，官方技術頁明列BCD、UHV及BCD-on-SOI電壓與節點，部分UHV平台定位green energy應用。本題材定位為綠能電源控制IC製程的間接供應環節，不是太陽能模組或逆變器整機；不能將700V製程直接等同光伏主功率元件訂單。 本次FinMind回傳2026年7月營收47.06億元，MoM-21.26%、YoY+30.25%。
products: 整合OTP／MTP的智慧電源管理IC製程
customers: 茂達（電源管理IC應用對象，非本次揭露客戶）
矽力杰（電源管理IC應用對象，非本次揭露客戶）

evidence.title: 公司完整基本資料（MOPS 54欄位版；2026-09-09查詢）
evidence.claim: 股票代碼5347；本次MCP成功取得主要經營業務，摘要：依客戶訂單與產品設計說明製造銷售積體電路，提供封裝測試、光罩製造設計與積體電路及晶圓半導體装置電腦輔助設計技術服務。主要業務不自動證實具名客戶或全部技術規格。

evidence.title: 2026年7月營收資料（2026-09-09查詢）
evidence.claim: 2026年7月營收47.06億元，MoM-21.26%、YoY+30.25%。來源原始當月值4705722000，單位NTD；TWSE主查詢回傳找不到月營收，改用FinMind；比較基期按revenue_year／revenue_month，不以資料列date誤判月份。 公司口徑，無本題材獨立收入拆分。

evidence.title: power-process（2026-09-09查詢）
evidence.claim: VIS技術頁明列BCD 5至120V／0.5至0.11µm、UHV 200至700V／0.5µm、BCD-on-SOI 10至200V／0.5至0.15µm，以及OTP／MTP、SiCr電阻；green energy包含照明、AC/DC等，不能全歸因再生能源。

techFocus: BCD 0.5µm至0.11µm元件整合及低比導通電阻設計

strengths: 官方提供BCD／SOI耐壓與製程範圍，支持電源管理技術角色
OTP／MTP及高精度電阻選項有利智慧電源控制IC整合
2026年7月營收47.06億元，MoM-21.26%、YoY+30.25%；為全公司口徑，不直接證明本題材貢獻。
weaknesses: 官網green energy同時包含照明與AC/DC等應用，不可全部歸類再生能源收入
未公布光伏逆變器、風電或儲能客戶與專案占比
